compute_descriptive_statistics: compute descriptive statistics for a dataset split from parquet files and return per-column statistics
check_extension_feature: check if a dataset feature is an arrow extension type like Array2D or Array3D
get_extension_features: get the names of all arrow extension features from a dataset features dictionary
run_split_statistics_job: run the split descriptive statistics job runner to compute column-level statistics for a dataset split
create_statistics_response: create a SplitDescriptiveStatisticsResponse with num_examples, per-column statistics, and a partial flag
